prompt:
Create ONE first-style-test illustration for a game's Golem story, landscape 16:9. Reference images 1 and 2 define the DRAWING STYLE: extremely simple hand-drawn chibi doodles, huge heads and very small squat bodies, thick slightly wobbly navy outlines, broad flat pastel fills, minimal detail, mitten hands, sticker-like white outer border, almost empty pink or butter-yellow background. Charming novice fan drawing. Match this simplicity throughout, NOT polished anime character art, NOT gouache/crayon painting, NOT realistic rendering. No complex anatomy, no busy setting, no gradients or metal reflections.
Reference3 is the ACTUAL ROBOT IDENTITY only. Translate it into the extremely simple doodle style of references1/2. Golem/Sentinel is an armored robot with a closed rounded charcoal/navy helmet, a short narrow YELLOW horizontal visor, dark armor, broad ORANGE chest plate with a little round center, round shoulder pads, orange lower-leg plates, orange boots. No human face, no exposed eyes, no mouth, no hair. Only a handful of chunky rounded shapes and contour lines. Preserve black/orange/yellow recognizable silhouette while stripping all machinery detail.
Scene for opening narration: Golem foreground slightly left of center, 3/4 body, one mitten hand resting over the little circular chest core and head tilted curiously toward the viewer. A tiny warm yellow four-point spark beside his chest suggests consciousness, no hearts or human face. Behind him to right are THREE smaller IDENTICAL robots standing obediently in a row, same helmet/visor/chest design, same chibi proportions and same minimal linework. They must look like copies of him, not different robot types. A tiny two-block gray government hangar shape and one simple straight floor line suggest the robot factory, nothing else. Background mostly plain pastel pink, small pale yellow circle behind main Golem. Keep characters and spark in upper/middle three quarters, leave bottom quarter uncluttered for future dialogue. No writing, no labels, no speech balloons, no panels. ONE image only.
status: First sample only. Awaiting user style approval; campaign not implemented.
